mintAuthority.summary: GRAMG has direct, immutable StableCoin deployments on Avalanche and Polygon. On Avalanche, EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb is both owner and supply manager. On Polygon, EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 is both owner and supply manager, while the Avalanche EOA is the live proposed owner and can claim ownership immediately. These direct mint() authorities remain in Mint Authority, where each current owner or supply manager can mint without an on-chain supply cap. The same contracts' issuer-controlled externalTransfer/externalTransferFrom burn/mint rail is assessed separately in Bridge Risk; Avalanche is the only deployment positively identified as canonical and Polygon's canonical-versus-representation role remains unresolved.

controls.label: GRAMG Avalanche supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, proposedOwner() was zero, and eth_getCode on the authority returned 0x. Verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: GRAMG Polygon supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 and eth_getCode returned 0x. The runtime hash matched Avalanche exactly for this asset, and verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: GRAMG Polygon pending-owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, proposedOwner() returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Verified Claimable ownership lets this EOA call claimOwnership without another current-owner action, after which owner() can mint or replace the supply manager immediately. eth_getCode returned 0x.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 92980453 and Polygon block 92143429 on 2026-08-16, both GRAMG deployments were direct contracts with identical non-empty runtime and no verified proxy, beacon, implementation, or admin path. Avalanche owner and supply manager were EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb; Polygon owner and supply manager were EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077, with the Avalanche EOA staged as proposed owner. Verified StableCoin source permits each current owner or supply manager to mint uncapped supply and permits the proposed owner to claim Polygon ownership without delay. Those native mint facts remain in Mint Authority. The separate externalTransfer/externalTransferFrom issuer rail is authored under Bridge Risk and has no verified peer, validator, escrow, replay, conservation, or rate-limit machinery. Avalanche is positively identified by issuer documentation as the canonical chain; Polygon's independent-liability versus representation role remains unresolved. Conflicting PAXG, bank-held-gold, and company-vault disclosures publish no quantities or liabilities reconciliation, so reconciliation remains unknown.
